newsitem.title: USA: MBIA-AMBAC to insure university bonds in Spain.
newsitem.headline: MBIA-AMBAC to insure university bonds in Spain.

text.p: MBIA-AMBAC International, a reinsurance joint venture between MBIA Insurance Corp and Ambac Assurance Corp, said Wednesday it will insure the first bond issue by universities in Spain.

"This transaction is a landmark deal in the European capital markets," said John Uhlein III, managing director - Europe of MBIA-AMBAC International. "This will mark the first time Spanish universities will issue bonds and the first time financial guarantee insurance will be used in the Spanish new issue market."
Proceeds from the Ptas 75.6 billion (US$523 million) offering will be used by five universities in the Valencia region. Societe Generale will serve as financial adviser.
"The innovative structure of this transaction could open the market for many other public infrastructure financings throughout Spain and Europe," Uhlein said.
The issue will consist of Ptas 46.8 billion (US$323 million) of bonds with maturities of 15, 20 and 25 years, and a Ptas 28.8 billion (US$200 million) loan from the European Investment Bank.
MBIA Insurance Corp through its Spanish branch, MBIA Sucursal en Espana, will insure the whole transaction.
Both Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's will rate the deal AAA. Societe Generale and Bankinter will be lead underwriters for the bond offering.
